fee_note: VIP 0 futures (USDT perpetual). Applies to all futures markets.
trigger_note: Toobit lets the user choose per order: tpTriggerBy/slTriggerBy/triggerBy = CONTRACT_PRICE or MARK_PRICE. No platform default found; league picks mark (conservative, avoids last-price wicks). Orders must set it explicitly.
liq_note: Toobit liquidation fee / liquidation price basis (mark vs last) not found in official docs. Engine uses Binance-style formula; fee left 0.

BTC.maint_amount_note: First tier: 0 by definition. Higher tiers' maint_amount not published by Toobit; not needed for paper positions within tier 1 (<=90,953 USDT notional).
